savefile.description: Path to the w2do save file. Defaults to ~/.w2do.

width.description: Line width for output. Minimal value is 75. Defaults to 80.

bare.description: Do not display table header and group separators. Maps to --bare/-b.

with_date.description: Display due date column. Maps to --with-date/-D.

verbose.description: Display all messages (verbose). Maps to -V/--verbose. If false, uses -q/--quiet.
